Marcus, I haven't saved the draft yet. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead. Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner, and Hollis isn't any of them. Even as a draft, sending them the rate needs sign-off from Anselm or June. Owning the account means you can see the rate yourself, but it doesn't let you share it with other people.

I've sent June a direct message asking for approval and logged the request. To June, I described it as "the proposed Thornbury 2027 per-seat rate" and left out the $2,101 figure. Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox (to hmbeki@pemberline.com, subject "Thornbury 2027 rate") so you can send it yourself.

Here's what it will say:

> Hi Hollis,
>
> For the territory review: Thornbury Cloth Co.'s proposed 2027 rate is $2,101 per seat, from my call with them on 13 October. It isn't in any document yet.
>
